description: Check transfer and one-way playlist-sync capabilities between two platforms using public slugs, such as spotify and youtube-music, or existing Soundiiz corenames such as ytmusic. Return supported item types and human-readable web guide URLs from the cached Soundiiz capability catalog. Show the exact returned guideUrl links, including query parameters, to users. This does not check account eligibility or live status. Results always use canonical public slugs.

destination.description: Destination public slug, for example youtube-music. Existing Soundiiz corenames, such as ytmusic, are also accepted.

source.description: Source public slug from https://soundiiz.com/capabilities.json. Existing Soundiiz corenames are also accepted; not a URL.

name: getSoundiizTransferCompatibility

generatedAt.description: Generation time of the cached capability snapshot in UTC.

guideUrl.description: Public web guide to show as a clickable link to the user; null when no guide is published.
Public web guide to show as a clickable link to the user; null when no guide is published.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status associated with this tool error.

retryAfter.description: Wait at least this many seconds before retrying.

title: Check Soundiiz transfer compatibility
